title: The complete ambient-health equivalence family has unbounded welfare losses
checked_scope: The scalar quadratic endogenous-avoidance model and its ambient-health nonidentification example, extended to the complete positive-parameter equivalence family.
significance: A full parametrization proves that perfect ambient-health data can leave welfare effects without any finite upper bound, and gives exact bounds from avoidance-fraction information.
